title: 第582章 暗探归仙峰伪天藏棋落人间第581章 立宗开道承上古一猫镇尽伪天蛊
slug: 喵仙宗主从猫薄荷开始证道长生
content_zh:
风停了。
破晓的光，薄得像纸。
铺在归仙峰的青石崖上，温柔得近乎虚假。
世人都爱看结局。
劫波散尽，山河无恙，新宗立道，万民归心。三界眼底，这是一场干净利落的胜局。
可懂棋的人都知道，最狠的杀招，从不在酣战之时。
在残局。
在静默。
在你以为尘埃落定的那一刻。
归仙峰顶，白衣静立。
林墨的指尖，早已收回虚空。
方才探入地脉的一缕灵力，像是触到了一块深埋万古的寒冰。冷，黏，无声，缠骨。
那是伪天蛊。
不是凶煞戾气，不会狂暴喷发，不会撕山裂地。
它更像一种病。
一种扎根山河灵脉、寄生人心执念、缓缓蚕食道统的沉疴。
看得见的刀兵易挡，看不见的腐朽难防。
脚边，胖橘蜷在晨光里。
绒毛晒得暖融融的，乍一看，就是一只贪睡懒动的寻常家猫。
谁都以为它在休憩。

只有林墨看得见细节。
它的尾巴，始终轻轻贴着地面，尾尖极慢、极轻地左右扫动，一秒一次，节律刻板，从不停歇。
每一次轻扫，一缕微不可察的上古道韵便沉入地底。
不张扬，不浩荡，不惊动任何生灵。
只静静镇压、安抚、净化那些缠在龙脉根骨上的灰黑蛊丝。
十万年猫仙道统，从不爱显威。
它护世，从来都是无声的。
林墨垂眸，目光落在这团软糯的橘色身影上，眼底掠过一丝极淡的松弛。
世人逐天道，争气运，抢仙位，斗得你死我活。
唯独这只猫。
守善，守生，守人间公道。
懒是皮囊，镇煞是本心。憨是表象，上古传承是根骨。
“立宗只是固本。”
他低声自语，嗓音清浅，被山风揉碎。
“真正的局，才刚刚开始。”
四堂初立，人心初聚，气运初凝。
喵仙宗的架子搭起来了，可内里依旧虚空。
灵脉有伤，地脉有蛊，仙盟有窥，伪天有算。
光鲜的新生道统之下，四面皆是暗涌。
山风掠过崖边，卷起一缕细碎草屑。

草屑升空，转了个圈，轻轻落地。
寻常景象，无人在意。
林墨的目光，却骤然微凝。
content_en:
The wind stopped.
The light of dawn is as thin as paper.
Paved on the bluestone cliff of Guixian Peak, it is so gentle that it is almost false.
Everyone loves to see the ending.
The waves of calamity have dissipated, the mountains and rivers are intact, new sects have been established, and all people have returned to their hearts. In the eyes of the Three Realms, this was a clean victory.
But anyone who knows chess knows that the most ruthless killing move is never in the heat of battle.
In the endgame.
In silence.
The moment you thought the dust had settled.
On the top of Guixian Peak, people standing quietly in white clothes.
Lin Mo's fingertips had long been withdrawn into the void.
The ray of spiritual power that had just penetrated the earth's veins seemed to have touched a piece of ice buried deep for eternity. Cold, sticky, silent, and bone-crushing.
That is pseudo heavenly Gu.
It's not vicious and violent, it won't erupt violently, it won't tear mountains apart.
It's more like a disease.
A kind of serious illness that takes root in the spiritual veins of mountains and rivers, parasitizes people's obsessions, and slowly eats away at the Taoist tradition.
Visible weapons are easy to block, but invisible decay is difficult to guard against.
At his feet, Fat Orange curled up in the morning light.
The fur is warm from the sun, and at first glance, it looks like an ordinary domestic cat that is sleepy and lazy.
Everyone thought it was resting.
Only Lin Mo could see the details.
Its tail is always lightly pressed against the ground, and the tail tip sweeps left and right very slowly and lightly, once a second, with a rigid rhythm and never stops.
With every swipe, an imperceptible trace of ancient Taoism sinks into the ground.
Not ostentatious, not grand, not disturbing any living beings.
He only quietly suppresses, comforts, and purifies the gray and black Gu threads wrapped around the roots and bones of the dragon's veins.
The Cat Immortal Taoism has been here for 100,000 years and never likes to show off its power.
It protects the world and is always silent.
Lin Mo lowered his eyes, his eyes falling on this soft orange figure, and there was a faint trace of relaxation in his eyes.
People in the world are chasing the way of heaven, fighting for luck, fighting for the immortal position, and fighting to the death.
Only this cat.
Keep good, keep your life, keep justice in the world.
Laziness is skin, restraining evil is true intention. Foolishness is the appearance, and ancient inheritance is the foundation.
"Establishing a clan is just to consolidate the foundation."
He whispered to himself in a low voice, his voice was clear and broken by the mountain wind.
"The real game has just begun."
The four halls are first established, people's hearts are first gathered, and luck is first condensed.
The Meow Immortal Sect's frame has been put up, but it's still empty inside.
The spiritual veins are injured, the earth veins are poisoned, the immortal alliance has a glimpse, and the false heaven has a plan.
Under the glorious new orthodoxy, there are undercurrents on all sides.
The mountain wind swept over the cliff, picking up a wisp of fine grass clippings.
The grass clippings rose into the air, spun around in a circle, and landed gently on the ground.
An ordinary sight that no one cares about.
Lin Mo's eyes suddenly narrowed slightly.
